fusions.name: Moonflower Sip
fusions.desc: Darts a barbed petal into one enemy for 4 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Mandrake Shriek
fusions.desc: Pulls up a mandrake that shrieks, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Nectar Draught
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Night-Blooming
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. You regenerate 1 health a second.
